spans.s: 1. ká-m, (ac. sg.) pcl. well: emphasizes 🞄a preceding dative.
2. ka-m, pcl. indeed (after nú, sú, hi).
kamaṭha, m. tortoise.
kamaṇḍalu, m. asceticʼs water-pot: 🞄-pāṇi, a. having a water-pot in the hand.
kām-anā, f. wish, desire.
kam-i, the root kam (gr.).
kampa‿uttara, a. trembling violently.

kambalá, m. (n.) woollen cloth, cover, 🞄or garment;
 -īśvara-grāma, m. N. of a village.
kamboja, m. pl. N. of a people.

kāmboja, a. coming from Kamboja;
 🞄n. N. of a people = Kamboja.
kam-ra, a. charming, beautiful.
kā́ma-mūta, pp. impelled by love.
kāmayā, (in. of) ad. frankly (with 🞄brūhi or pra-brūhi).

kāmukā-ya, den. Ā. play the lover: 🞄pp. -yi-ta;
 n. conduct of a lover.
kāma‿īśvará, m. ep. of Kubera.
kāma‿unmatta, pp. mad with love.

kāmpil-ya, n. N. of a city of the 🞄Pañcālas: -ka, m. a plant;
 -laka, m. id..
kāmbuva, m. N. of a locality.
kāmyā, f. desire, wish for, striving 🞄after (g., —˚).
